claims.claim_text_en: The 2024 spring floods displaced people and caused losses: about 12,000 displaced in the Northern basin with USD 90 million in losses (p. 8); 15,000 displaced in the national disaster table (p. 30).
claims.open_issue: Check whether 12,000 vs 15,000 is a scope difference (basin vs national) or a conflict.

relations.rationale: Both report people displaced by the 2024 floods with different values and scopes.

brief.core_idea_en: NDC 3.0 records the 2024 spring floods as the country's major recent disaster impact. The narrative on p. 8 reports about 12,000 people displaced in the Northern basin and USD 90 million in losses; the disaster table on p. 30 reports 15,000 displaced nationally. No risk assessment or loss-accounting system is described in the pages read.

concerns.text_en: The 2024 spring floods displaced thousands of people and caused large losses; the two displacement figures differ.

numbers.text_en: About 12,000 displaced and USD 90 million in losses, Northern basin, 2024 (NDC 3.0, p. 8); 15,000 displaced, national, 2024 (p. 30).

gaps.text_en: The difference between 12,000 and 15,000 is not explained; it may be scope.
No hazard mapping, risk assessment or loss database is mentioned in the pages read (1, 8, 12, 21-22, 30).
